items.question: What B2B lead generation services do you offer?
items.answer: Seven core services: LinkedIn Outreach and Automation, Cold Email Infrastructure, ICP Mapping and Lead Scoring, AI Lead Generation, Account-Based Marketing, Personal Branding and GTM Strategy. Each one is productized and run for you, and most clients combine two or three, such as cold email and LinkedIn on the same accounts.

items.question: How is AI used in your lead generation services?
items.answer: Our AI agents research, qualify and prioritise leads at scale, which removes most of the manual research time. We also use AI to personalise cold email and LinkedIn messages around each prospect's context. People set the targeting and review the output, so every message stays accurate, relevant and human.

items.question: Do you work with B2B companies outside Mumbai?
items.answer: Yes. We are based in BKC, Mumbai, and work with B2B companies across India and internationally, 130+ so far. Every engagement runs remotely over calls and a shared dashboard. Our city pages describe how we work with the industries in each market, but there are no separate city offices.
